A01.summary: Shown: json_talk_topic loads dynamic_line, speaker_effect, optional portrait_override, ordered responses and repeated inventory-driven responses. Dynamic lines allow translated strings, concatenation, random arrays and conditional branches. Response conditions can hide choices or produce a failure explanation/topic; trials require a failure effect. talk_effect_t::apply runs effects, changes NPC opinion, checks hostility and returns the next topic. Thus speech can alter world state. Some dynamic-line evaluation also clears a reason value, so text generation is not universally pure. Optional speaker-effect sentinels build a topic-scoped variable on the first actor, combine it with the condition, and set it after the effect. A base-data example BGSS_EVACUEE_2_STORY1 gates a social trial on a temporary NPC effect, branches to a later topic on success and applies that effect on the failure topic.
